fields.statement: At c44cd76a7: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/guide -run 'Build|Review' -v passes; TestBuildText and TestReviewText now require 'rhiza session done', 'as its own command' and '`;` or `&&`', and build.md/review.md both say each role ends with rhiza session done as its own command after its recording command succeeded, never chained with ; or &&. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/workflow passes, including new TestBuiltinPromptsDoneOwnCommand, which scans every builtin (BuiltinNames) prompt naming rhiza session done for '; rhiza session done', ';rhiza session done', '&& rhiza session done' and requires 'very last action'. Read the diff: all prompts in build, plan, plan-milestone, review and ship-change .toml are single-line, and grep shows no session done mention outside prompt lines, so the scan covers them all.
